description: nf-core/viralintegration samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 0.1.1 nextflow_schema.json and assets/schema_input.json. Detects viral integration sites in a host genome via chimeric reads.

viral_fasta.help: The VIRAL database searched for integrations. The schema default is a remote Broad URL, so the first run downloads it — stage it locally on Luria if runs are repeated.

min_reads.help: Minimum chimeric reads to call an integration site.

pipeline.name: nf-core/viralintegration
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. sample and fastq_1 are required.
pipeline.reference_requirement: TWO references, and they are different things: the HOST genome via --genome/--fasta/--gtf (all three are declared at 0.1.1), and the VIRAL database via --viral_fasta, which has a remote default.

validation_rules: The --genome/--fasta/--gtf reference is the HOST, and --viral_fasta is the virus. Do not conflate them.
0.1.1 is the ONLY release and an early one. Treat results as provisional and check the pipeline's own caveats before reporting them.
The default viral_fasta is a remote Broad URL; the first run downloads it. Stage it on Luria for repeated use.
min_reads is the sensitivity knob — lowering it finds more sites and more false positives.
notes: NO MATCHING DATA IN NExtSEEK as of 2026-08-05: no viral cohorts registered. Catalogued for future data. Pinned at 0.1.1 because that is the only release; re-derive reference_cli_flags if a later version appears.

sources.label: nf-core/viralintegration nextflow_schema.json @ 0.1.1
sources.notes: Authoritative: viral_fasta / remove_duplicates / min_reads / max_hits are required but all carry defaults; genome, fasta and gtf are all declared.

sources.label: nf-core/viralintegration assets/schema_input.json @ 0.1.1
sources.notes: Authoritative columns: sample and fastq_1 required.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/viralintegration input sheet.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/viralintegration sheet from a resolved D.SEQ cohort of host libraries suspected of carrying viral insertions.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected for questions like 'where did HPV integrate in these tumours?'.
population_priority: Resolve the HOST reference from the cohort's organism, as normal.
Confirm with the user which viral database to search; the default is a broad Broad-hosted set.
final_checks: Host and viral references are distinct and each is correct.
The user knows this is a 0.1.1 pipeline.
